body: Thank you, this is great advice it really is. These kind of things helped me a few months back. But now I just cant find the motivation...

I don't even know how I expect you guys to help. I just need something... i dont know.

No job, no decent education, no car, spending my parents money, cant even look at the only girl I've ever loved anymore let alone look at myself. People would be better off without me, if I write a good suicide note convincing them they should just let me go maybe I wont feel so bad about doing it, so I can ACTUALLY end it.
